overview: The Upper Terrace is the pinnacle of Shar Vahl ceremonial tradition, where clan rites culminate and royal ceremonies are performed.
history: The Upper Terrace was constructed as the final stage of clan rites.
Royal ceremonies were moved here after the Vah Shir settled on Luclin.
Arcane pylons were added to channel ritual energy skyward.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the terrace was expanded and reinforced.
Shadow-Threat Watch began monitoring ritual anomalies after arcane surges.
hooks: A major ritual misfires, destabilizing arcane pylons.
A royal ceremony requires urgent assistance.
Ancestral flame pillars flicker with corruption.
A planar surge erupts during a clan rite.
